title: PRIVATE 3-hour COMPLETE tour of Montréal in convertible Cadillac
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the original, fan-favorite Cadillac tour in our exclusive 3-hour version! Enjoy a private, personalized ride in one of our iconic vintage Cadillac convertibles, guided by a local expert. Unlike typical bus tours, our relaxed journey lets you explore Montreal in comfort and style. With the top down, you’ll enjoy unobstructed views as we cruise through Old Montreal, where you'll learn about the city’s history and structures dating back 380 years. You’ll see landmarks like Notre-Dame Basilica, Bonsecours Market, and cobblestone streets from Montreal’s early French settlement. In the second hour, we’ll explore the vibrant Plateau with Victorian homes, iconic staircases, and murals. In the third hour, we’ll head up Mount Royal for a peaceful break from the city and views of the skyline. Our guides will share insider tips on the best restaurants, events, and activities. Cover more ground than walking, all at a relaxed pace—tailored just for you!
